General fund Taxes 3,213,398 split into property 2,920,256 and motor vehicle 293,142 per Exhibit D General column (p4). General fund Local 851,607 and Road Local 33,714 split per the General and Road columns of Exhibit D (p4) with split_from; the General Fund interest part 369,503 is Interest Income (re-check 2026-10-28); their budget_final amounts are not split (null).
